cannot_infer_from_weights: action translation units or rotation feature scale
dropout probability or train/eval inference mode
training epochs, optimizer state, learning rate or EMA use
identity with the paper checkpoint or reported architecture
requires_grad flags or a universal trainable-parameter count
checkpoint.interpretation: Names and tensor shapes support compatibility checks. They do not establish the historical training configuration; state_dict elements can include frozen parameters and buffers.

asset_identity.dataset_role_proved: Published ZIP test member, regardless of its local validation-like filename
asset_identity.dataset_role_not_proved: Paper test split identity, or derivation from the last 128 training samples

training_windows.unscanned_field_reason: Both ordered ID windows already differ from test; complete record equality is impossible, so actions/heights were not scanned.
training_windows.scope: Only the first/last window was compared; interior membership, split origin, and paper test identity are not established. Fields marked null were not checked.

provenance.scope: Local preparation manifest records retrieval/extraction; it does not establish checkpoint training provenance.
